channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The day after Nvidia lost its founder-CEO, the clearest signal came from buyers paying for power before they sign leases. Fermi said an unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler agreed a $200 million prepayment and a $15 million early-works deal to advance 600 MW at Project Matador in Texas from 2027, with no lease yet; the same release said Fermi's August lease with AMD-backed TensorWave is terminated. Cerebras signed Microsoft as its third hyperscaler customer and has 700 MW under contract, but expects cloud revenue to stay flat this quarter because new capacity only starts ramping in December. NAVER sold 20 MW of 2027 capacity to a US inference company for about 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion). On Nvidia, Reuters reports interim CEO Colette Kress pushed back on Huang's large financing deals, including investments in OpenAI and Lambda, that a proposed $250 billion plan to support OpenAI's Ohio project was pared to $120 billion, and that the stock fell as much as 14% on Thursday before closing down 4.3%. List prices held for a fifth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 13 November 2026
item.description: The day after Nvidia lost its founder-CEO, the clearest signal came from buyers paying for power before they sign leases. Fermi said an unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler agreed a $200 million prepayment and a $15 million early-works deal to advance 600 MW at Project Matador in Texas from 2027, with no lease yet; the same release said Fermi's August lease with AMD-backed TensorWave is terminated. Cerebras signed Microsoft as its third hyperscaler customer and has 700 MW under contract, but expects cloud revenue to stay flat this quarter because new capacity only starts ramping in December. NAVER sold 20 MW of 2027 capacity to a US inference company for about 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion). On Nvidia, Reuters reports interim CEO Colette Kress pushed back on Huang's large financing deals, including investments in OpenAI and Lambda, that a proposed $250 billion plan to support OpenAI's Ohio project was pared to $120 billion, and that the stock fell as much as 14% on Thursday before closing down 4.3%. List prices held for a fifth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: United States: Unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler prepays $200 million for 600 MW at Fermi's Project Matador; TensorWave lease terminated (Wire, 12 Nov, confirmed). United States: Cerebras signs Microsoft, 700 MW under contract, RPO $26.1 billion; capacity ramps from December (Wire, 12 Nov, confirmed). South Korea: NAVER signs 2 trillion won, 20 MW AI Factory contract with a US inference company; 55 MW in 2027, 200 MW by 2028 (Wire, 12 Nov, confirmed). Australia: AirTrunk Lane Cove and Stockland Cooks River projects cancelled, Tungkillo paused; CDC refiles Kemps Creek at 1.4 GW (Wire, 12 Nov, corroborated). Kazakhstan: Gcore and TengriAI MoU to explore up to 100 MW GPU data centre, 2027 to 2029 (Wire, 12 Nov, single-source, MoU).
